import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad: Base() { fun bad(value: Hidden): Hidden = value }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad: Base() { fun bad(value: PackageType): PackageType = value }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad: Base() { fun <Result> bad(): String = Result.make("x").tag() }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad<Result>: Base() { fun bad(): String = Result.make("x").tag() }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad: Base() { fun <Result> bad(): Any = Result("x") }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad: Base() { class Result; fun bad(value: Base.Result): Result = value }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Other
import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Other.Result
class Bad: Base() { fun bad(): Result = Other.Result() }

import inherited.library.JavaTypes.Base
class Bad { fun bad(): String = Protected.tag() }

import inherited.library.KotlinBase
class Bad: KotlinBase() { fun bad(value: KHidden): KHidden = value }
